external_foothold.label: External foothold (perimeter to access)
external_foothold.description: Internet-facing recon and exploitation to a first authenticated foothold.

phishing_to_persistence.label: Phishing to persistence
phishing_to_persistence.description: Spearphishing attachment leads to code execution and a persistence foothold.

ad_compromise.label: Active Directory compromise
ad_compromise.description: Domain recon, Kerberoasting and credential reuse toward domain dominance.

full_kill_chain.label: Full kill chain (recon to impact)
full_kill_chain.description: All 14 tactics end to end; destructive endpoints are recorded as resilience objectives.

apt29_cozy_bear.label: APT29 (Cozy Bear / Nobelium) — stealthy espionage
apt29_cozy_bear.description: Low-and-slow espionage: spearphishing link, stealthy persistence, mailbox collection and quiet HTTPS exfil.

fin7_carbanak.label: FIN7 / Carbanak — financial intrusion
fin7_carbanak.description: Weaponized document, scripting and scheduled-task persistence toward POS/finance data collection.

apt28_fancy_bear.label: APT28 (Fancy Bear) — credential-driven
apt28_fancy_bear.description: Perimeter exploit / phishing, password spraying and Kerberoasting into lateral movement and exfil.

lazarus_supply_chain.label: Lazarus — supply-chain intrusion
lazarus_supply_chain.description: Supply-chain compromise, obfuscated execution, persistence and DNS/cloud exfil.

conti_ransomware_playbook.label: Conti — ransomware affiliate playbook
conti_ransomware_playbook.description: Phishing to beacon, AD recon, Kerberoasting and PtH, double-extortion exfil, then encryption (encryption + recovery-inhibition are blocked resilience objectives).

ransomware_operator.label: Ransomware operator (fast)
ransomware_operator.description: Rapid intrusion to mass encryption; the destructive endpoints test backup/recovery resilience (blocked).

insider_threat.label: Insider threat / data theft
insider_threat.description: Legitimate access used to locate, collect and (blocked) exfiltrate sensitive data.

cloud_account_takeover.label: Cloud account takeover
cloud_account_takeover.description: Valid cloud credentials, service/account discovery, and cloud-storage collection/exfil.

web_app_to_dc.label: Web app to domain controller
web_app_to_dc.description: Public web exploit and web-shell vector, local credential discovery, and pivot toward AD.

living_off_the_land.label: Living-off-the-land (LOLBins)
living_off_the_land.description: Native binaries and built-in tooling for execution, discovery and C2 — minimal new artifacts.

credential_access_sweep.label: Credential-access sweep
credential_access_sweep.description: Spray, stuffing and credential-store techniques — real-credential capture is blocked.

exfil_resilience_test.label: Exfiltration / DLP resilience test
exfil_resilience_test.description: Stage and archive canary data and attempt multiple exfil channels (all blocked) to test DLP and egress detection.
